fact: SSMO's catalogue of Sudanese Standards lists Sudanese Standard 4469:2018, an information technology standard on the yield of printer toner cartridges, as equivalent to ISO 19752:2017, and Sudanese Standard 1633-1:2015, on metadata for records, as equivalent to ISO 23081-1:2006.

ISO's member page lists the Sudanese Standards and Metrology Organization as Sudan's ISO member body and an affiliate member of IEC, with 37 participating and 10 observing technical-committee memberships.
